RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 30

An all-male panel is unremarkable in senior municipal hiring — it reflects who holds those posts, and on its own proves nothing about this decision. Leading with it invites the panel to feel accused and to close ranks, and it shifts attention away from your strongest facts.

Those are: a documented credentials gap (master's, licence, twelve years versus a bachelor's), and a two-week silence on a reasonable written request. Press those. Send a follow-up citing the relevant policy or statute, ask for the scoring criteria, weightings and your scores, and ask what "extensive experience of public consultation" was weighted against.

Note the panel composition in your own records. If the scores reveal unexplained gaps, it becomes relevant context then — not now.
